Kforce's retail client in Northern California is seeking a Data Analyst with end-to-end experience with analytics workflow from post-ingestion data modeling through end-user consumption for a fully remote contract.

Responsibilities:
 
  Own analytics and reporting projects end to end, from requirements gathering through source data transformation, modeling, and final delivery in Sigma 
  Write, optimize, and maintain complex SQL including stored procedures, views, and scheduled tasks in Snowflake to support robust, production-quality data pipelines 
  Design and implement data models and semantic layers that serve as the foundation for business reporting across merchandising, marketing, inventory, and operations 
  Build and maintain business-facing dashboards and reports in Sigma, designing for clarity, usability, and self-serve access by non-technical stakeholders 
  Validate and QA data at every stage of the pipeline, ensuring accuracy and reliability of outputs before delivery to stakeholders 
  Partner with business stakeholders to translate reporting requirements into technical specifications, managing expectations on scope, timelines, and tradeoffs throughout delivery 
  Document work clearly, follow established best practices for intake and delivery, and manage personal workload across multiple concurrent projects 
  Handle ad hoc and urgent data requests while maintaining quality and accuracy, flagging tradeoffs or risks proactively 
 
 
  2-4 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related field; Retail or e-commerce experience a plus 
  Advanced SQL skills including stored procedures, views, and query optimization; Hands-on experience with Snowflake and a modern BI platform (Sigma preferred) 
  Proven ability to design and implement data models and semantic layers that support reliable, scalable reporting 
  Comfortable owning projects end to end and working directly with business stakeholders to gather requirements and manage delivery 
  Experience building polished, user-facing dashboards and reports designed for self-serve use by non-technical business stakeholders 
  Able to manage personal priorities and delivery timelines in a fast-paced environment 
  Clear communication and documentation skills for both technical and non-technical audiences 
  Working knowledge of retail performance drivers across merchandising, marketing, inventory, and/or operations 
  Organized, proactive, and able to balance competing priorities while maintaining quality
